data.standardized_narrative: Unable to reliably extract prior year reserve opening balance or gross prior-year development from the supplied scanned images. The report images are low-contrast, rotated and many numeric tables (Balance Sheet, Technical Provisions, Movement in provision notes and Claims Development tables) are not machine-readable in these images, so gross claims outstanding and gross prior year reserve movement could not be identified with confidence.
data.data_quality_notes: PDF pages were provided as images with rotation and low OCRability. I could not confidently locate the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' (gross) prior-year closing balance or a clear 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' showing the insurance liabilities (gross) figure. The only reasonably legible value located was the gross written premiums (approx. 287,115 in GBP 000 on the Profit & Loss technical account), converted here to millions (287.115). All reserve-related fields are null due to inability to verify gross claims outstanding and gross prior-year development from the scanned pages. Provide a text-searchable PDF or a crop of the Balance Sheet / Technical Reserves movement notes for precise extraction.
